_comment: Realm world-mood rotation. Read by server/Set-Mood.ps1 (-Season, -Event, -List). Mood ids are folder names under mods/presets/. Explained in mods/moods.md. seasonLooks lists optional alternatives an owner may pick by hand with -Mood instead of the cycle's mood; Set-Mood.ps1 does not read it.

grim-but-readable.name: Grim but Readable
grim-but-readable.summary: Baseline: cool grey light, mixed weather. The Thaw and the default between arcs.

golden-summer.name: Golden Summer
golden-summer.summary: Warm honey light, thin haze, almost no rain, slightly longer days.

storm-season.name: Storm Season
storm-season.summary: Rain most of the time, slate light, wet fog. Clear skies are rare.

long-winter.name: Long Winter
long-winter.summary: Pale cold sun, low grey skies, icy fog, a bright cold moon.

spring-rains.name: Spring Rains
spring-rains.summary: Fresh green-gold light, a light mist, showers but never a storm.

hunters-moon.name: Hunter's Moon
hunters-moon.summary: A copper moon, amber afternoons, valley mist, grey days without storms.

first-frost.name: First Frost
first-frost.summary: Crisp blue-white light, a bright cold moon, thin air, mostly clear.

blood-moon.name: Blood Moon
blood-moon.summary: Red moon nights under clear skies. A season finale overlay, not a season.

crown-night.name: Crown Night
crown-night.summary: A gold moon over a violet haze, clear skies. The weekly Crown Night overlay.

truce.name: Truce
truce.summary: Soft pale light, thin air, no rain. For a scheduled Truce of the Realm.

ashfall.name: Ashfall
ashfall.summary: Brown-grey ash haze, orange sun, dry overcast. A short war-arc overlay.

harvest-festival.name: Harvest Fair
harvest-festival.summary: A low amber sun, an orange harvest moon, golden haze, dry skies. RealmWorld's Harvest Fair week.

midwinter.name: Midwinter
midwinter.summary: A bright silver-blue moon, a pale cold sun, frost haze, still skies. RealmWorld's Midwinter week.
